parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. You can specify multiple backup plan IDs, separated by commas

parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the backup plan is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html operation to query the list of supported regions
parameters.help_zh: DBS地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html接口查看DBS支持地域
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数，取值为1~100。

默认为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为：0
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup plan
parameters.name: backup_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup plan. Valid values:

wait: The backup plan is not configured.

init: The backup plan is not started because a precheck failed.

running: The backup plan is running.

stop: The backup plan has failed.

pause: The backup plan is paused.

locked: The backup plan is locked.

check_pass: The precheck is passed
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划状态，取值：

wait：未配置
init：未启动（预检查失败）
running：运行中
stop：失败
pause：暂停
locked：锁定中
check_pass：预检查通过
parameters.name: backup_plan_status

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求

parameters.name: resource_group_id
